sport.weightLossCenter.kind.reminder.des: We recommend starting with the goal of losing 3 kg in 30 days (approximately 0.5 to 0.75 kg per week). This speed allows the body to gently adapt to the changes while also fostering sustainable healthy habits. The World Health Organization recommends a safe and scientifically sound rate of 0.5 to 1 kg per week. Losing weight too quickly can lead to muscle loss and decreased metabolism, while a gradual approach is more conducive to maintaining an ideal weight over the long term. The current setting is in this healthy weight loss range.
